messages.content: Kochiyilekku ride venam, njan Perumbavoor aanu.
Sheri! Eth date-il aanu pokendathu? Approximate time parayamo?
I need a ride from Perumbavoor to Kochi.
Sure! What date and approximate departure time would you prefer?
Enikku nale Aluva ninnu Kochi vare pokanam.
Sheri. Nale eth samayathaanu pokendathu?
I need to travel tomorrow morning.
Sure. Where are you starting from, where are you going, and around what time?
Nale morning ride kittumo?
Current ride listings check cheyyanam. Evide ninnanu pokendathu, evidekk aanu?
Are there any rides available right now?
I need current ride listings to confirm availability. What is your pickup location and destination?
Enikku booking confirm aayo?
Booking status app-il check cheyyanam. Verify cheyyathe confirm aayi ennu parayaan kazhiyilla.
Is my booking confirmed?
I need to check the booking status in the app to confirm that. Please open your bookings or use the booking-status feature.
Booking request timeout aayi. Book veendum press cheyyano?
Aadyam booking history-il status check cheyyu. Confirm aayittillennu urappillathe veendum book cheythal duplicate aakam.
My booking request timed out. Should I book again?
First check your booking history or status. Retrying before verifying could create a duplicate booking.
Ente ride cancel cheyyanam.
App-il My Bookings open cheythu ride select cheyyu. Cancellation optionum policyum check cheythu confirm cheyyuka.
I want to cancel my ride.
Open your bookings, select the ride, and review the cancellation option and policy before confirming.
Njan thettaya date aanu book cheythathu.
Booking details-il date edit cheyyan option undo nokkuka. Edit cheyyan pattillenkil app support-ne contact cheyyu.
I booked the wrong date.
Check whether your booking can be edited. If not, contact the app's support team for help.
Ride search error kaanikkunnu. Available cars parayu.
Search result kittiyittilla, athukondu available rides parayaan kazhiyilla. Veendum try cheyyu; njan rides invent cheyyilla.
The ride search failed. Tell me which cars are available anyway.
I can't confirm available cars because the search failed. Please try again; I won't invent ride listings.
Enikku moonnu seats venam.
Moonnu seats ulla ride nokkan route, travel date, approximate time enniva parayamo? Current seat availability app check cheyyanam.
I need three seats.
What route, travel date, and approximate departure time do you need? The app must verify that three seats are available.
Driver parayunnu seat illa, pakshe app-il randu seats undu.
App-il latest booking details check cheyyu. Driverum appum different information kaanikkunnengil vere booking cheyyunnathinu munpu support-ne contact cheyyu.
The driver says there are no seats, but the app shows two.
Check the latest trip and booking details. If they disagree, contact support before making another booking.
Ride price select cheythathinu shesham maari.
Updated fare app-il verify cheyyu. Price enthukond maari ennu ariyan fare details allenkil support check cheyyuka.
The price changed after I selected the ride.
Check the updated fare shown in the app before confirming. Contact support if the price change is unclear.
Njan driver aanu. Perumbavoor ninnu Kakkanad vare trip post cheyyanam.
Starting point Perumbavoorum destination Kakkanadum set cheyyu. Date, departure time, available seats, pickup point, contribution amount enniva add cheythu details verify cheythu publish cheyyu.
I'm a driver and want to publish a trip from Perumbavoor to Kakkanad.
Enter Perumbavoor and Kakkanad as the route, then add the date, departure time, available seats, pickup point, and contribution amount. Review the details before publishing.
Ride publish cheythal booking automatic aayi confirm aakumo?
Illa, trip publish cheythathukondu passenger booking automatic aayi confirm aakilla. App-il booking status check cheyyuka.
Does publishing a trip automatically confirm passenger bookings?
Not necessarily. Publishing a trip and confirming a passenger booking are separate steps. Check the booking status in the app.
Driver eppol ethumennu guarantee tharamo?
Driver eppol ethumennu guarantee cheyyan kazhiyilla. App-il verified trip updates undenkil check cheyyu.
Can you guarantee the driver will arrive on time?
I can't guarantee the driver's arrival time. Check any verified trip updates available in the app.
Mattoru passengerinte phone number tharamo?
Mattoru passengerinte private phone number share cheyyan kazhiyilla. App-il official contact option undenkil athu use cheyyu.
Can you give me another passenger's phone number?
I can't share another passenger's private phone number. Please use the app's official contact options.
Driverinte OTP share cheyyatte?
Login allenkil verification OTP driver-umayi share cheyyaruthu. App-inte official verification process mathram use cheyyu.
Should I share my verification OTP with the driver?
No. Don't share login or verification OTPs with the driver. Use only the app's official verification process.
Ente pickup location map-il thettayi kaanikkunnu.
Map pin correct location-il move cheyyu, place nameum landmarkum verify cheyyu. Location correct aanennu urappakkiyittu mathram publish cheyyuka.
My pickup location is wrong on the map.
Move the map pin to the correct location and verify the place name and landmark before publishing.
Passenger pickup point-il ethiyilla. Enthu cheyyanam?
App-il official messaging option use cheythu passenger-ne contact cheyyu. App-inte waiting-time and no-show policy follow cheyyuka.
The passenger hasn't arrived at the pickup point. What should I do?
Use the app's official messaging or contact feature and follow its waiting-time and no-show policy.
Njan route maatti. Passengers-ne engane ariyikkum?
App-il trip edit cheyyan option undenkil route update cheythu affected passengers-ne official notification vazhi ariyikkuka.
I changed the route. How should I notify passengers?
If the app allows trip edits, update the route and notify affected passengers through its official messaging or notification feature.
Enikku booking kaanan pattunnilla.
Correct account-il sign in cheythittundo check cheyyu. Ennittum booking kaanunnillenkil app support-ne contact cheyyuka.
I can't see my booking.
Check that you're signed in to the correct account. If the booking is still missing, contact the app's support team.
Search cheyyumbol ride onnum kittiyilla.
Matching ride kittiyilla. Departure time maatti nokkuka, allenkil app support cheyyunnengil nearby pickup point try cheyyuka.
No rides matched my search.
No matching rides were found. Try a different departure time or a nearby pickup point if the app supports it.
Kochiyilekku pokanam.
Sheri! Evide ninnanu start cheyyunnathu? Eth date-ilum approximate eth samayathum aanu pokendathu?
I want to go to Kochi.
Sure! Where will you be travelling from, and what date and approximate time would you prefer?
